run_migrate_imports_dry_run: run a dry run to preview import path replacements in a Python or YAML file
run_migrate_imports_execute: execute import path replacements across all Python and YAML files in a directory
run_migrate_imports_single_file: run import migration on a single file to replace old fairchem module paths
review_replace_strings_in_file: review the replace_strings_in_file function that performs string replacements with dry run support
refactor_mapping_entries: refactor the mapping dictionary to add new old-to-new import path replacement entries
